===Format===
* '''Knockout:''''' <section begin="KnockoutFormat"/>November 10th - 19th, 2023
** 18 teams.
** ''Round-Robin Format:'' 18 teams split into 3 groups of 6.
** 2 weekends:
*** Each with 3 matchdays.
*** Each matchday consist of 6 matches.<section end="KnockoutFormat"/>
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 12 teams}} qualify for ''Points Rush'' and  ''Grand Finals''.
<div style="margin-top:12px"></div>
* '''Points Rush:''''' <section begin="PRFormat"/>November 24th - 25th, 2023
** 12 teams.
** 6 matches each day.
** Teams will receive ''Headstart Points'' after each day based on their daily standings.<section end="PRFormat"/>
<div style="margin-top:12px"></div>
* '''Grand Finals:''''' November 26th, 2023
** 12 teams.
** 6 matches.
